coaching.headline: Our one ahead lane (The Fey mid) kept skipping the early fights — the other four kept fighting without him and lost the map. Objectives 12-28.
coaching.team: Three lanes were behind all game, but the fights show the real bleed: The Fey mid was even-or-ahead and ALIVE, yet flagged 'never joined' at the 9m, 11m, 12m and 16m fights — so the team kept opening 5-mans without their best player and losing them. The 9m river fight is a textbook bad trade: even bodies (5v5), no objective up, and we flipped a coin-toss with two players absent. Then once lanes cracked, the 20m and 22m fights had two pinned, losing lanes who couldn't help — those were the wrong fights to start. The 30m loss bought us Orb Prime, so read that one as a trade, not a throw. Two fixes: when one lane is ahead, that player shoves and rotates so we fight 5v5 with our strongest body — and don't take open-map coin-toss fights with no major up. Itemize armor too: the film flags Khaimera and Zinx with none into a physical-heavy enemy (their Murdock did 34k).
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Three lanes were behind all game, and four players kept fighting while the one ahead lane sat mid — fight after fight we were a body short of even. Get the winning lane to rotate before committing, and don't flip a no-objective 5v5; reset and take vision/farm instead.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: The Fey mid, 4/5/8 and team-high 36.6k — Mr_Meat31's lane was the only one ahead, which makes the early fights the story: Mr_Meat31 was alive and not there for the 9m, 11m, 12m and 16m fights the team lost. When ahead and pushed in, shove the wave and rotate to the fight so the team isn't a body down. The Wraith Leggings spike (~19m) is exactly when those roams hit hardest.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zinx into Rampage offlane was theirs at every checkpoint — 5/10/3, ten deaths into a losing matchup with no item spike to swing it. By 20m and 22m Willy Guggenheim was the pinned, losing body who couldn't rotate, so the team taking fights without Zinx was on the wrong side of the numbers. Stop trading into Rampage before the items are online; farm safe and let the team group on Zinx's terms, not Rampage's.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Khaimera jungle, 3/10/2 — the Zarus matchup read theirs all game, and Cuban Noobster never finished the core (no Basilisk/Rapture) or bought armor into a 3-physical comp. Cuban was in most of the losing skirmishes; the fix is to stop forcing fights into a lead that isn't there — full-clear to the items first and reset instead of contesting a fight a body short.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Drongo carry, 2/8/4 into an even Murdock lane — even at every checkpoint means it was winnable, but eight deaths and an unfinished core (no Vanquisher/Imperator) sank it, and Goldilocks324 was flagged absent from the early fights too. Play the even lane safe, complete the core, then group — when the lane is even, the player who joins the fight first is the one who tips the numbers.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Argus support, 2/6/8 into an unfavored Aurora (theirs through 25 minutes) — behind the matchup with no spike to swing it, and Xeebs was the pinned, losing body in the 11m fight the team took without Xeebs. When the lane is losing, don't get caught out as the body down; play safe and ward so the team doesn't fight 5 with Xeebs stranded.

synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.

morigesh.loadout: Vesh (The Tenth Seal + Mind Rot), augment Cursed Infestation, crest Epoch
lines: Curse at top rank: 75s base, about 52.4s by the end (30% shorter) from 43 ability haste: Megacosm 10, Epoch 8, ultimate haste 25.
Morigesh dealt 27,877 hero damage, 23% of their team's, with +400 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against Argus (level 17 estimated: about 47 magical armor, 27 after penetration) and Khaimera (level 17 estimated: about 60 magical armor, 40 after penetration) that is about 16% and 14% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 20.2% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
The Tenth Seal (Eternal minor): At Level 10, gain 5% Ultimate Damage and 25 Ultimate Ability Haste.
Mind Rot (Eternal minor): The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.
Cursed Infestation (augment): Hive deals 10% more damage and has 10% increased range.
Toughness: +250 health; took 24,736 damage, mitigated 12,545, died 3 times.

Lesson: Morigesh's penetration cut through: Argus took about 16% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 47, about 27 after 20 flat penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Megacosm, Wraith Leggings, Vesh, Mind Rot. Morigesh has 4 damaging abilities (Hive hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 18 ability haste brought them back 15% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Damage that scales with our health): 2 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Mind Rot. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on our side fed them.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (The Tenth Seal + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; damage that scales with our health), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Morigesh killed built magical armor. Health items on Argus raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Morigesh 3 times.
Copy it? Vesh: 47.6% in 1,735 Morigesh midlane games, level with the hero's 47.6%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

card.lesson: Curse came back about every 52s instead of 75s by the end (30% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

aurora.loadout: Idrisil (Frost Snap + Glacier), augment Glacial Thorns, crest Leafsong
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 33 minutes, fewer deaths than about 87% of Aurora support players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Cryoseism at top rank: 110s base, about 76.9s by the end (30% shorter) from 43 ability haste: Dynamo 10, Galaxy Greaves 10, Tainted Guard 8, Elafrost 15.
Aurora dealt 13,534 hero damage, 11% of their team's, with +0 magical power from items.
Dynamo (item): On Immobilizing an Enemy: They take 8% more damage for 2.5s.
Tainted Guard (item): On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Elafrost (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 70 (+2%) Damage On-Hit around the Target. Slows by 35% for 1.5s. Damage is increased by 60% against Monsters.
Frost Snap (Eternal minor): Deal 10% Bonus Damage to Immobilized or Slowed Targets.
Glacial Thorns (augment): Glacial Charge spawns Hoarfrost Crystals at its base that deal 40/60/80/100/120 (+20%) Damage and Root for 0.5s.
Sustain: Tainted Guard: On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.; 4,722 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1345 health, +210 physical armor, +30 magical armor; took 32,076 damage, mitigated 46,964, died 1 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Guard, Elafrost.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Aurora killed built magical armor. We killed Aurora 1 time.
Copy it? Idrisil: 53.5% in 217 Aurora support games, above the hero's 51.7%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Cryoseism came back about every 77s instead of 110s by the end (30% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

the-fey.loadout: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot), augment Natural Infusion, crest Soulbearer

fightBonus.note: 10 per Harvest Nettles hit for 6s; Harvest Nettles comes back every 2.1s at 42 haste, so up to 3 stacks if every cast hits

fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Tithe of Death (minor): Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.
Nature's Vengeance (passive): Each time The Fey achieves a Takedown she spawns an Untamed Growth from the Enemy Hero's corpse and gains 30% movement speed for 3s.
lines: Lead story: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate. In 75% of the team's kills (more than 98% of The Fey mid players this patch) and died 5 times (fewer than about 48% of them). Tithe of Death turned 12 takedowns into ability haste, so Fly Trap came back every ~67s instead of 95s.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one The Fey touched shortened Fly Trap, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 66.9s late, about 55.2s mid-fight); fight right after Fly Trap is spent.
Fly Trap at top rank: 95s base, about 66.9s by the end (30% shorter) from 42 ability haste: Tainted Scepter 10, Soulbearer 8, Tithe of Death (minor) 24.

Mid-fight, Natural Infusion (augment) adds up to 30 more (10 per Harvest Nettles hit for 6s; Harvest Nettles comes back every 2.1s at 42 haste, so up to 3 stacks if every cast hits): Fly Trap about 55.2s (estimate).
Tithe of Death (minor): 2 per takedown, 12 takedowns.
12 takedowns (4 kills, 8 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice), Tithe of Death (minor), Nature's Vengeance (passive).
The Fey dealt 36,628 hero damage, 37% of their team's, with +410 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against Zarus (level 17 estimated: about 60 magical armor, 40 after penetration) and Murdock (level 17 estimated: about 46 magical armor, 26 after penetration) that is about 14% and 16% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 20.2% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Mind Rot (Eternal minor): The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.

Sustain: Tainted Scepter: On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 2,936 healing recorded.
Toughness: +200 health; took 26,500 damage, mitigated 13,296, died 5 times.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Vesh, Mind Rot. The Fey has 4 damaging abilities (Untamed Growth, Bramble Patch hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 42 ability haste brought them back 30% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Tithe of Death. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Soulbearer.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; every takedown fed), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players The Fey killed built magical armor (Aurora). Anti-heal on Aurora, Murdock, Rampage, Zarus. We killed The Fey 5 times.

Copy it? Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot): 48.8% in 1,932 The Fey midlane games, below the hero's 51.4%; this 3-item core: 52.6% in 504 games, below the 55.8% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

card.lesson: The Fey's takedowns fed Fly Trap: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Fly Trap is used.

lead.title: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate
lead.text: In 75% of the team's kills (more than 98% of The Fey mid players this patch) and died 5 times (fewer than about 48% of them). Tithe of Death turned 12 takedowns into ability haste, so Fly Trap came back every ~67s instead of 95s.

stacks.title: Every ability hit set off

members.name: Combustion
members.text: On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.

members.name: Wraith Leggings
members.text: Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.

members.name: Vesh
members.text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.

members.name: Mind Rot
members.text: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.

stacks.text: 4 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Vesh, Mind Rot. The Fey has 4 damaging abilities (Untamed Growth, Bramble Patch hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 42 ability haste brought them back 30% sooner: more casts, more triggers.

stacks.title: Every takedown fed

members.name: Tainted Scepter
members.text: Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.

members.name: Tithe of Death
members.text: Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Tithe of Death. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; every takedown fed), so the same hits paid out twice.

countered.text: 1 of the 3 players The Fey killed built magical armor (Aurora).
Anti-heal on Aurora, Murdock, Rampage, Zarus.
We killed The Fey 5 times.

copy.text: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot): 48.8% in 1,932 The Fey midlane games, below the hero's 51.4%; this 3-item core: 52.6% in 504 games, below the 55.8% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
